subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a public channel SDK capability for caption-capable final-mode TTS, or should this fix stay Telegram-internal until the broader TTS delivery-mode policy settles?
rationale: The code path looks like a sound bug fix, but it expands plugin-facing channel semantics and changes message delivery ordering, which automation should not finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept public capability after proof
options.body: Keep the SDK capability shape, require current-head Telegram proof for always and tagged modes, then land once normal gates pass.

options.title: Make it Telegram-internal first
options.body: Avoid exposing reusable plugin API now and keep the behavior tied to the bundled Telegram implementation until another channel needs it.

options.title: Defer to delivery-mode policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the separate text-plus-voice delivery preference is resolved into one TTS delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Accept public capability after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the SDK capability shape, require current-head Telegram proof for always and tagged modes, then land once normal gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest inspected history across the dispatch lifecycle, current blame, and merge ownership for the settlement seam this PR uses.
